senses.gloss:
युप् युप्, cl. 4. P. युप्यति, युयोप, अयु-
पत्, &c., to confuse, trouble, perplex; to
efface, destroy, obliterate; to make level or smooth;
to be concealed, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I.
104, 4. युयोप = गूढम् आसीत्): Caus. योपयति,
यितुम्, to efface, obliterate, destroy: Intens. यो-
युप्यते.

यूप यूप, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.
III. 27. fr. rt. 2. यु, ‘to bind;’ but according to
some, more probably fr. rt. युप्), a smooth post or
stake to which the sacrificial victim is fastened, any
sacrificial post, (usually made of bamboos or Khadira
wood; in Rāmāyaṇa I. 13, 24, 25, where the horse
sacrifice is described, twenty-one of these posts are
set up, six made of Vilva, six of Khadira, six of
Palāśa, one of Uḍumbara, one of Śleṣmātaka, and
one of Deva-dāru); a column erected in honour of
a victory, a trophy (= जय-स्तम्भ); N. of a par-
ticular conjunction of the class आकृति-योग (i. e.
when all the planets are situated in the first, second,
third, and fourth houses).
—यूप-कटक, अस्, m. a
wooden ring at the top of the sacrificial post; (ac-
cording to some) an iron ring at its base.
—यूप-
कर्ण, अस्, m. the part of a sacrificial post which is
sprinkled with ghee.
—यूप-केतु, उस्, m., N. of
Bhūri-śravas.
—यूप-च्छेदन, अम्, n. the cutting
of the sacrificial post.
—यूप-दारु, n. the wood
for the sacrificial post.
—यूप-द्रु, उस्, m. Acacia
Catechu (the wood of this tree being especially suit-
able for the sacrificial post).
—यूप-द्रुम, अस्, m.
= यूप-द्रु above; = रक्त-खदिर.
—यूप-
ध्वज, अस्, m. ‘having the sacrificial post as an
emblem,’ epithet of the sacrifice (personified).
—यू-
प-लक्षण, अम्, n., N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of Kātyā-
[]
yana.
—यूप-लक्ष्य, अस्, m. a bird (said to be so
called as ‘having a post [round which a snare is
tied] for its aim’).
—यूप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having
a sacrificial post.
—यूप-वाह, अस्, m., Ved. the
carrier or bearer of the sacrificial post.
—यूप-
व्रस्क, अस्, m. the cutter of the sacrificial post.
—यूपाक्ष (˚प-अक्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa,
(also read यूपाख्य.)
—यूपाग्र (˚प-अग्˚), अम्,
n. the top of the sacrificial post.
—यूपाहुति (˚प-
आह्˚), इस्, f. an offering at the erection of the sacri-
ficial post.
—यूपोच्छ्रय (˚प-उच्˚), अस्, m. the
ceremony of erecting the sacrificial post.

यूपीय or यूप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit or suitable for
a sacrificial post.
